d: In Surat, Gujarat, a massive labour movement by embroidery factory workers has drawn nationwide attention as thousands of migrant workers left the city for their villages, protesting against 14-15 hour workdays, denial of weekly Sunday holidays, and unpaid or delayed wages. Labour leader Ajay Dubey, who heads an organisation fighting for workers’ rights, led the agitation including a gherao of the collectorate.
